en: The postcard displays a colored, vintage image of a landscaped avenue or promenade bordered by trees and classical columns on the left. In the background, a villa or building is partially visible among lush greenery. The sky shows a subtle gradient from blue to pink, suggesting a sunset or sunrise. The text 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Neue Anlagen' is printed on the front, indicating the location and the name of the area. The reverse side shows handwritten German cursive text, a stamp from the Deutsches Reich era, and is addressed to someone in Frankfurt. There's also a large stylized 'M' logo with the text 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT.' The date '1908' is written on the card.
